name: GoTrail
tagline: A hiking app that identifies plants offline with an on-device model and turns each hike into a collection.
problem: People prescribed hiking find it boring or intimidating, and trails often lack service.
solution: A native iOS app runs a plant-identification model on the phone through ZETIC Melange, logs hikes with stats and a map, and builds a collectible species log.
demo_moment: Team-described: point the camera at a plant with no signal and add it to the collection.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Works exactly where hikers lose signal.

lessons: A collection mechanic everyone knows makes a health habit stick.
